rulesets.b: Hollow Knight inspired hand-drawn 2D game art: clean smooth dark linework, muted desaturated palette, soft painterly cel shading, bug-like chibi proportions, melancholic fairy-tale tone. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-rendered. A BOSS, much larger presence than a common monster. THREE-QUARTER FRONT, FULL BODY. LAYOUT: EXACTLY SIX CELLS, 3x2, magenta gaps, common baseline. Background: completely flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF. No text, no labels, no borders.
